scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev --workspace @cubic/api" "npm run dev --workspace @cubic/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @cubic/api && npm run build --workspace @cubic/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @cubic/shared && npm run build --workspace @cubic/database
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
